name: Protagonist
source:
He is an only child. His father is [url=/c100657]Gerald[/url], a Navy lieutenant, and his mother died at a young age. When he was eleven, [url=/c100646]Ashley[/url] moved in and he met [url=/c100643]Childhood Friend[/url], his step-sister (customizable to half-sister), but five years later, [url=/c100646]Ashley[/url] broke up with his father and cut all ties with them.

Once he graduated from high school, he studied pre-law and met his current girlfriend [url=/c100645]Nicole[/url]. A couple of years later he moved in together and bought their first appartment with her.
